title: Friend View
description:
Friend View lets you follow your friends' play in Slay the Spire 2 co-op with a dedicated read-only demo view. See what they are holding, how they move and select cards, and which card rewards they are considering.

[h2]Watch your friend's play[/h2]
[list]
[*]View their hand, energy, health, powers and relics.
[*]Follow their cursor and animated card movements, hovering and selection.
[*]Observe their reward list, available card rewards and selected card.
[*]Keep watching a living teammate after your own character dies.
[*]Switch between friends in co-op sessions with more than two players.
[/list]

[h2]Simple controls[/h2]
Click the eye beside a friend's status in the player list to enter demo view. The active friend's eye and avatar turn green. Click the active eye again or press Esc to return to your own view.

When viewing card rewards, the exit eye appears to the right of the cards. To watch another friend's card rewards, exit first, then click their eye in the player list.

[h2]Observation, not control[/h2]
You cannot play, drag or select your friend's cards, or claim rewards while observing. Your native End Turn button still ends your own turn. Exit demo view to choose your own rewards and continue normally. Friend View adds viewing controls without changing card effects, combat rules or the save format.

[h2]Installation[/h2]
Every player in the co-op lobby must use the same version of Friend View and the game. Enable it through Slay the Spire 2's built-in mod loader. No additional mod loader or library is required.

Friend View focuses on combat hands and reward screens; it does not mirror shops, events or separate relic-selection screens.

[h2]Your normal progress[/h2]
When Friend View is the only successfully loaded cosmetic mod, the game uses your normal profile. With any other mod or a loading error, the game's separate modded profile remains in use. The profile choice stays fixed until you restart the game. Friend View does not copy, merge or delete save files; the game saves the selected profile normally. The MODDED indicator remains visible.
